title: Horton Summer 2017 finals game 2: Ambassador, Soothsayer, Donate, Wall
quality_note: Designer's playtested deck, but nobody built it at the tournament and Horton only says he thinks it is quite good.

kingdom.setup_notes: Tournament rule: players may arrange their starting decks, so they choose a 4/3 or 5/2 opening.

edition: First-edition Ambassador. Pillage and Donate are pre-errata here (Pillage no longer works when Throne Roomed; Donate now resolves at the start of your next turn).
